Definition: from G4982; the body (as a sound whole), used in a very wide application, literally or figuratively:--bodily, body, slave.
BiblicalUsage: The body is three things at once in Paul's writing. Your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you, and ye are not your own; the church is the body of Christ, many members yet one body, with Christ as the head; and Paul begs believers to present their bodies a living sacrifice, holy and acceptable unto God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the body is not a shell to escape but a temple to keep and an offering to give. I hold that Christ is the head and we are His members, and what we do with our bodies is worship.
